defs.def: a place to live, work or stay in 住处；办公处；停留处
somewhere to live or stay, often also providing food or other services 住宿；膳宿

ex.s: I ask them to repeat themselves a lot!” Although some foreign students live in campus accommodation, Xie Lei chose to live with a host family, who can help with her adaptation to the new culture.
ex.t: 我要求他们经常重复自己的话！ “虽然有些外国学生住在校园住宿，但谢磊选择与寄宿家庭住在一起，他们可以帮助她适应新的文化。

ex.s: ·You’ll get airport pickup, accommodation with breakfast, free-time activities
ex.t: 你会得到机场接机、含早餐的住宿以及空闲时间活动安排的服务。

ex.s: I’ve also booked accommodation based on the budget we made.
ex.t: 我也根据我们制定的预算预订了住宿。

ex.s: The working hours are flexible and accommodation is provided.
ex.t: 工作时间灵活，提供住宿。

ex.s: From there, you’ll spend one day travelling by boat to your accommodation in the middle of the forest.
ex.t: 从那里，您将花一天时间乘船前往森林中的住所。

ex.s: You don't have to book accommodation in advance as you will certainly manage (find) a local person who will offer 5 (put) you up at a very reasonable price.
ex.t: 您不必提前预订住宿，因为您肯定会管理（找到）当地人，他们会以非常合理的价格为您提供5个住宿。

defs.def: an agreement or arrangement between people or groups with different opinions which is acceptable to everyone; the process of reaching this agreement 和解；调解；调和
